criteria.label: Comprehension
criteria.question: Is the meaning faster or easier to grasp in B than A?

criteria.label: Text burden
criteria.question: Does the structured form reduce how much prose must carry cognitively?

criteria.label: Truthfulness
criteria.question: Does B preserve exact meaning without implying extra semantics?

criteria.label: Visual distinctiveness
criteria.question: Does B look meaningfully different from ordinary prose or controls?

criteria.label: Prose complementarity
criteria.question: Does prose explain the representation rather than merely decorate it?

criteria.label: Restraint
criteria.question: For prose-only controls, does the absence of visualization feel appropriate?
